Chloe — quick diagnostic from my end. I pulled the GCal event metadata for the Opsys invite. What happened looks like a common forwarding artifact: the customer forwarded the original invite from Outlook which replaced the organizer attribute (external forwarder becomes organizer in some clients) and Google stripped the Meet anchor because the forwarded iCal lacked the X-MICROSOFT-CDO-BUSYSTATUS metadata we use to keep the original conference data. Result — event exists but the join anchor is empty on recipients' views.

Workaround (my recommended path):
1) I will generate a temporary Zoom session for the demo (link below).
2) I'll attach an updated .ics to a new event and set Redwood as the organizer before sending — that preserves an explicit conference entry.
3) Chloe/opsys accept the new invite; I'll include dial-in numbers in the event body.

Zoom (temporary): https://zoom.us/j/9876543210 (passcode: 482193)
Proposed .ics attached: proposed-ics.ics

If you prefer Meet instead of Zoom, I can force a new Meet link too, but Meet sometimes gets stripped again when forwarded from Exchange. Zoom is more resilient here.
